scope: Offline follow-up using frozen Core and tau8 Core+Normal aggregates; tau202 is not adopted
target: Frozen national SCE initial-release headline; full-wave common-score human reconstruction is a separate measurement bridge
features: Last eligible public SCE level; latest eligible BLS first-release CPI-U yoy minus SCE anchor; that CPI release minus the preceding CPI yoy release; simulated SCE minus anchor
regime: CPI yoy >=4 percent, fixed illustrative threshold, not optimized; dummy and dummy times simulated-minus-anchor
response: Current national SCE minus public SCE anchor
selection: Fit early36, minimize next12 MAE; ties prefer larger alpha. Refit selected alpha on early48, seal coefficients, then evaluate later34. All transforms fit only on the corresponding training rows.
convex_blend: Fit MAE/MSE weights only on early48 using the existing fit_weight implementation; retain both objectives
information_boundary: Macro CPI/anchor follow each original monthly shared reference cutoff. Full-month A simulations have personal dates, so these combined predictors remain retrospective A diagnostics, not certified common-cutoff B forecasts.
limits: Only 82 monthly observations, not 98382 independent macro observations
Later historical months have been viewed previously; this is not a new blind test
CPI and regime terms require matched no-simulation controls to identify simulation's incremental predictive contribution
No model selected or promoted by later34 results
Density fitting, valid-sample, weights, quantile interpolation and publication precision can all contribute to the official/common-score bridge
